title: BLR program after choosing an input
statement:
Let $n$ and $r$ be natural numbers, let a seed map send each $r$-bit string to an element of $(
\mathbb F_2)^n$, and let $x$ be an $n$-bit input. The resulting query program samples an $r$-bit string uniformly, incurs the specified local-work charge, and then runs the query procedure using the encoding of $x$ and the seed map’s output.
hypotheses_covered: A seed map from $r$-bit strings to $(\mathbb F_2)^n$
caveat: The referenced local-work charge and query procedure are not defined in the supplied statement, so their meanings cannot be specified more precisely.
